scope: Selected original prompts, token histories, acquisition manifests, and historical evaluation reports. No activation payloads or model weights.
limitations: Historical reports are not newly validated model measurements.
20 and 8 prompt batches are subsets of the 51 prompt collection, not independent prompt corpora.
Token CSVs are retained in their original collection-specific schemas.
No hidden/router binary arrays, GGUF files, model-derived gate weights, or executables are included.
